document.querySelectorAll('.submenu-toggle').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const expanded = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
    const submenu = btn.nextElementSibling;

    // Toggle this submenu
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !expanded);
    submenu.hidden = expanded;

    // Accordion behavior: close all others
    document.querySelectorAll('.submenu-toggle').forEach(otherBtn => {
      if (otherBtn !== btn) {
        otherBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        otherBtn.nextElementSibling.hidden = true;
      }
    });
  });
});

document.querySelector('.hamburger').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('menu-toggle').click();
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menu-toggle');
    if (menuToggle.checked) {
      menuToggle.checked = false;

      // Close all submenus too
      document.querySelectorAll('.submenu-toggle').forEach(btn => {
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        btn.nextElementSibling.hidden = true;
      });
    }
  }
});
